newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Baring Asset says manages $3 bln for Gulf clients.
newsitem.headline: Baring Asset says manages $3 bln for Gulf clients.

text.p: Baring Asset Management is investing around $3 billion abroad for Gulf investors, chief investment officer James Williams said on Wednesday.
"Baring is investing around $3 billion outside the region on behalf of Gulf clients," Williams told Reuters. He declined to name the investors or their countries.
He said the London-based Baring was also investing $25-30 million on the Egyptian stock market for its clients.
Baring Asset Management opened a representative office in Bahrain last year. It manages equity, fixed income and cash portfolios.
Williams said the group was also investing around $6 billion in South East Asia including Hong Kong, Singapore and India, and another $4.5 billion in Japan.
